payload.body: ISSUE:0001 PASSES validation at 1b6e29e. Independent run on an exact git-archive export, built into its own target dir: fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test (28 unit, 21 CLI, 1 ignored), the ignored Keychain test, build, tests/release.sh, the signing unittest, actionlint and shellcheck all PASS. vc's black-box check (isolated HOME and XDG, 16 checks: first run, help, unknown command and option, and bare versus explicit for no args, --all, --all --json, --json, --refresh, --verbose and --config PATH) is 16 of 16 green; on 0.1.5 it was red on exactly the 11 behaviours the issue changes. Every Acceptance item is met, and the help and README wording read cleanly. vc is closing ISSUE:0001 on this verdict; drop your claim on it when convenient. Live use on hv's real accounts waits for ISSUE:0002, because a pre-fix local build would prompt.
